items.title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
items.feed_excerpt: We created a list of the most notable AI agents that can live in your text messages, from general assistants to agents designed for families, travel, and work.

items.title: Tesla turns to Turo to boost adoption of Full Self-Driving (Supervised)
items.feed_excerpt: Eligible Turo hosts will also get a one-month free trial of Tesla's FSD software.

items.title: Meta AI director Rohit Patel leaves to take on Microsoft Office and Google Workspace
items.feed_excerpt: Rohit Patel is departing Meta after eight years working on AI evaluations and reinforcement learning, TechCrunch has exclusively learned. His startup, Ndoc, aims to take on Microsoft Office Suite.

items.title: Japan internet giant GMO says hackers posted stolen customer data
items.feed_excerpt: Japan's GMO Internet is verifying alleged customer data posted by suspected hackers following a cloud service breach.

items.title: Billionaire Palmer Luckey isn’t leaving California over the wealth tax
items.feed_excerpt: "It's causing a lot of people to run who I don't want to be running," native Californian Palmer Luckey said. "But I'm planning on staying in California. I'm going to keep fighting it."

items.title: Anduril, Qualcomm launch BlueChip, a new kind of US-made laptop
items.feed_excerpt: Anduril founder Palmer Luckey is vowing to bring computer manufacturing back to the U.S. and by that he doesn't just mean assembly, but every individual component, some of which are exclusively made in China today.

items.title: General Compute raises $100 million Series A, countering the neocloud disaster narrative
items.feed_excerpt: General Compute is betting on inference chips from outside the Nvidia ecosystem.

items.title: Opera introduces a new web standard to let users deploy AI locally in their browser
items.feed_excerpt: The new standard, WebAI, is designed to work with a variety of AI models.

items.title: Nvidia backs Indian startup helping companies run AI models with fewer GPUs
items.feed_excerpt: Simplismart says its annualized revenue run rate has grown 14-fold in six months, with the U.S. accounting for more than half its revenue.

items.title: Re:Build, which spun out Slate Auto, raises $2.1B
items.feed_excerpt: The manufacturing accelerator bills itself as "America’s answer to Shenzhen."

items.title: Disruptive raises $10B fund to make big bets on at least 10 companies
items.feed_excerpt: Disruptive has made headlines in recent years for pouring money into companies like chip startup Groq and the AI voice-generation startup ElevenLabs.

items.title: Frontier AI labs say their models refuted the Exponential Time Hypothesis. What does that mean?
items.feed_excerpt: TechCrunch spoke to the MIT computer scientist charged with explaining OpenAI's latest mind-bending discovery.

items.title: Google’s Genie 4 world model adds audio, more realistic worlds, and real-time steering
items.feed_excerpt: Genie 4 can maintain a consistent scene for up to two minutes, double Genie 3's limit, and offers better physics and more humanlike characters.
